headline: The wingman brings you home
lede: R-TYPE co-op got its courtesy: when the stage clears, a pilot whose tickets burned while the partner carried the run returns with one free life — naked hull, fresh mercy, seat keys and all.

notes.text: #2980 (POLISH — the idle-kick's R-TYPE pick): a dark seat comes back at every stage-clear loop with exactly one life; seat two's row blinks SEAT IN, seat one's lives line blinks PILOT IN, and a rising chime rings the return. Symmetric both ways, and a fare not a refill — if both pools burn on the gate, the curtain still falls.

Late in a long browser leg real-time key pulses starve to rAF throttling — the first stage-clear laws never saw the gate fall. The fix: drive loop legs with deterministic __game.step batches. That recipe now rides the game README for the next loop-law author.

rtypecheck 263/263 with eight new laws; mutants dark-deaf and fare-blind go red by design. Winnability re-measured: solo 8/12 (floor 4), co-op 12/12 — the fare is zero-rng and every tuned stream replays byte-identical.
Jon's #2846 landed while this shift ran: CONTRA, DOUBLE DRAGON and R-TYPE are now public on the arcade, pinned by a visibilitycheck allowlist.
